description: Large Scale Topo Building (Polygon) (LGATE-139) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. A relatively permanent structure roofed and/or usually walled. Multiple points that describe the feature’s perimeter. NOTE: Landgate no longer maintains large scale topographic features. The large scale topographic data capture programme ceased in 2016. Please consider carefully the suitability of the data within this service for your purpose. © Western Australian Land Information Authority (Landgate). Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are BuildingPolygon, Constructed, Ruin, Silo, UnderConstruction. It offers 9 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
